messages:
maria: Heads up — thinking about a 'split-path' rollback signal for staged rollouts. Goal: signal that prefers a lower-latency fast-path (cut to fallback) without dropping mirrored/deferred mirror traffic. Anyone see obvious pitfalls?
ajay: Love the idea. Main tradeoff: how fast to propagate the signal vs avoiding noisy flips. We need a dampening window + quorum on errors?
dave: If we fanout rollback immediately to data-plane we might cause cache churn and thundering style evictions. Alternative: emit a 'soft-abort' first (route new sessions away) then 'hard-abort' after X failed probes.
sophia: Proposal: two-tier signal: 'divert' and 'evict'. divert = route new requests to fallback, keep existing sessions; evict = flush sessions and KV caches. divert should be quick and reversible.
ajay: Agreed. Also separate latency thresholds from error-rate. e.g., if p95 > 2s AND error-rate > 1% -> divert. If error-rate stays high for 2m -> evict.
maria: How do we carry this in the control plane? Option A: centralized signal bus (kafka-like) with versioned signals. Option B: local observer per-region that publishes to region topics.
dave: Local observer preferred for speed and blast radius. Publish a compact signal proto: {signal_type, reason, generation, ttl, origin}. Data-plane subscribes to the local topic and applies idempotently.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary v3 -> 10% @ us-west-2 (runbook id: RB-452) :rocket:
sophia: We need idempotent semantics. generation number + monotonic lease prevents replay. Also make diversion a per-tenant override (owners can opt-out).
ajay: Mirroring: continue mirroring into warm storage (deferred mirror) for offline eval. Don't mirror into the live cache when diverted to avoid pollution and cost. Mirror writes should be tagged with signal.generation.
maria: What about fanout reliability? If a node misses the signal it could keep serving older variant. Use heartbeat + reconcile job. If reconcile finds generation mismatch, escalate to node restart or local fallback.
dave: Also expose a lightweight API: GET /signal/status -> {last_seen_generation, last_seen_ts} for ops to query node health.
sophia: Edge case: control-plane partition. Nodes should prefer a 'safe' state if they lose heartbeats > threshold. That means autonomous fallback is allowed if no control-plane contact for Xs.
ajay: Rough node decision pseudocode:
```
if lost_heartbeat_for > 30s:
    goto fallback
elif signal.divert and signal.generation > node.generation:
    route_new_requests(fallback)
elif signal.evict:
    terminate_sessions_and_flush_cache()
```
maria: We should instrument 'rollback_latency' metric: time from signal origin to 90% of traffic diverted. Add dashboard + alert if > 10s. Also track p50/p95 of diversion.
sophia: Also track 'mirror_lag' (deferred mirror ingestion latency) so offline evals know data freshness. Tag mirror records with signal.generation and tenant-id.
dave: :thumbsup: I'll draft an RFC with the signal proto, per-node state machine, durable reconcile loop, and runbook excerpts (soft-abort vs hard-abort steps).
maria: Thanks — please ping when draft lands. @ajay @sophia wanna review the metrics and ops runbook sections?
